about:
Sofa Square Furniture makes solid wood and fabric sofas in its own workshop in Koramangala 1st Block, Bengaluru.
Bring your room measurement and pick the shape, seat depth, fabric and finish. We build it to fit.
We also make booth and banquette seating for cafes and restaurants, built to your floor plan and seat count.
